user_query: I want to organize a charity event and need to gather information about the attendees. Fetch the details of our employees and provide me with the access settings stored for our company. Also, generate a list of the most recent lead data from our campaign on FomoAPI.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the details of all employees involved in the charity event.
Fetch the company's access settings to understand permissions and security configurations.
Generate a list of the most recent lead data from the campaign using FomoAPI.
